How It Works

Step 1

Place Your Order

Check out our current weekly menu posted every Wednesday morning. Select a meal package, subscription, or custom order. Orders must be placed by Friday at midnight.

Step 2

Pickup

Choose your nearest pickup location in checkout. Pick up from your selected location on Tuesdays from 4:00-7:00 PM each week.

Step 3

Enjoy

Enjoy healthy, fresh, macro-balanced meals for the whole week!

Who We Are

Who We Are

Fueled Right is driven by a passionate commitment to revolutionize the way people approach healthy eating. We understand the demands of modern life and the challenges of maintaining a healthy diet. That’s why we embarked on a mission to make healthy eating convenient, accessible, and downright delicious. Our team is passionate about creating fresh, never frozen meals that cater to your dietary needs without compromising on flavor.

We prioritize sustainability, so you can feel good about what you’re putting into your body. We believe that eating healthy shouldn’t be a daunting task but an enjoyable experience that contributes to a happier and healthier life. We take care of the meal prep, so you have more time for the things that truly matter to you.
Whether you’re a busy working mom, a fitness enthusiast, a working professional, or simply someone who wants to feel better and more energized, Fueled Right is here for you.
